data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves showed a small overall release of approximately $0.383m (gross) driven by favourable development on the 2015 underwriting year. The balance sheet opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was $2.536m. While the SPA experienced material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey and Irma which increased the 2017 net loss ratio, the only measurable prior-year development identifiable from the gross claims development table is a modest favourable movement on 2015.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not provided as a single explicit gross movement figure. The reported prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative incurred triangle) for underwriting year 2015 only. No explicit textual sentence quantifying a gross prior-year movement was found. All monetary values are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and have been converted from $'000 to millions. Confidence for the PYD is 0.8 as it is calculated from the triangular data.
